name: Trade Freedom: Public pages load correctly

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage at https://demo2.tradefreedoms.com and verify it loads with the Trade Freedom branding
The homepage displays the Trade Freedom logo, hero section, and market data section
The login page shows email and password input fields and a login button
The register page shows registration form fields
The spot trading page loads with a price chart and order form
The option trading page loads with trading interface
The terms page displays terms and conditions content
The privacy page displays privacy policy content
The download page shows app download options
The support page loads with contact or help options
